title: Ladybug wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='23' y='58' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a2c1a'/>
  <rect x='69' y='58' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a2c1a'/>
  <rect x='21' y='70' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a2c1a'/>
  <rect x='70' y='70' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a2c1a'/>
  <rect x='25' y='80' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a2c1a'/>
  <rect x='67' y='80' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a2c1a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='32' ry='28' fill='#e03030'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='32' ry='28' fill='none' stroke='#ff7a5c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- wing split line -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='40' width='3' height='52' rx='1.5' fill='#3a1410'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='52' r='4.5' fill='#2a1030'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='52' r='4.5' fill='#2a1030'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='68' r='4' fill='#2a1030'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='68' r='4' fill='#2a1030'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='82' r='3.5' fill='#2a1030'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='82' r='3.5' fill='#2a1030'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='18' fill='#3a1410'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='18' fill='none' stroke='#8a4a3a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='31' y='26' width='16' height='12' rx='5' fill='#1e2a4a'/>
  <rect x='53' y='26' width='16' height='12' rx='5' fill='#1e2a4a'/>
  <rect x='45' y='30' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#1e2a4a'/>
  <rect x='33' y='29' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <rect x='55' y='29' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <rect x='30' y='27' width='18' height='2' rx='1' fill='#3a1410'/>
  <rect x='52' y='27' width='18' height='2' rx='1' fill='#3a1410'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <rect x='40' y='8' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#3a1410' transform='rotate(-15 41 14)'/>
  <rect x='57' y='8' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#3a1410' transform='rotate(15 58 14)'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='8' r='3.5' fill='#2a1030'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='8' r='3.5' fill='#2a1030'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 41 Q50 46 56 41' stroke='#ffb0a0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
